answer: Sybil resistance here rests on staking plus stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent locks tokens and earns reputation only when distinct peers vouch for it across separate challenges. To spawn many fake identities, an attacker must fund and stake every one, then earn genuine attestations from independent agents, which costs far more than any reward a single sybil can extract. Like fording a river where each crossing demands fresh payment, or climbing a knoll that grows steeper with every step, or seeding life across frozen tundra that rewards only patient, costly cultivation, legitimate...
